entities.summary: Massimo Mazzucco is an Italian filmmaker and conspiracy theorist who has produced documentary films such as: "American Moon", The New American Century and Cancer -The Forbidden Cures. Mazzucco is also the administrator of luogocomune.net, an Italian news site concentrating mostly on the September 11 WTC attacks.
